findings: All seven incoming and all three outgoing bodies were read in full, including every retained body paragraph.

No genuinely distinctive link identifies any one of the seven incoming letters as the source of 311, 317 or 318; shared specimens, geology, plants, cargo and Cambridge logistics remain background only.
The strongest contextual continuity is Henslow’s established advisory and cargo-handling relationship, but it does not meet source-specific attestation for promotion.
limitations: XML date bounds and sent-date constraints are preserved; receipt timing is not treated as exact.
